title: The campaign audience preview works for a Space with more than 1,000 contacts

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), Space email review of #3359 (EMAIL-021).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: in strict mode readSpaceContacts asks for count 'exact' with .limit(5000) and throws 'Audience preview incomplete' when count differs from the rows returned. PostgREST caps a response at max_rows = 1000 (supabase/config.toml and the hosted default), so above 1,000 contacts the picker shows the retry state forever; this replaced the old live count, so the largest Spaces regressed. THE FIX: read contacts in pages of 1,000 with .range() up to MAX_RECIPIENTS, compare against min(count, MAX_RECIPIENTS), and report a count over the cap as a separate capped state.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/\.range\(/.test(r('lib/spaces/audiences.ts'))){console.error('SCAN-829: the strict audience read is one capped page, so a Space over 1,000 contacts never previews');process.exit(1)}"
